title: Can You Take the Life in the UK Test Online?
excerpt: No. You book online, but you sit the test in person at an approved test centre.
description: Can you take the Life in the UK test online? No: you book online but sit it at an approved test centre. Here's how booking and the test day work.
body:
No, you can't take the Life in the UK test online. You book it online on GOV.UK, but you sit the test in person at an approved test centre.

## How booking works

You book on the official GOV.UK website at least 3 days before you want to take the test. You'll need an email address, a debit or credit card, and the ID you'll bring on the day. Only book through GOV.UK so you don't pay extra fees to third-party sites.

## Where you take it

There are approved test centres across the UK. You choose the centre and date when you book. The test itself is taken on a computer at the centre.

## What to bring

- The same ID you used to book
- Arrive early: if you're late, you may not be allowed to sit the test

## What about practising online?

Practice is a different story: you can prepare fully online. Free mock tests let you practise with the real format of 24 questions in 45 minutes, so the computer-based test feels familiar on the day.

Always check GOV.UK for the latest rules before you book. Try a free mock test below to see where you stand.
